quest.title: The Forest Boar and the Little Witch
quest.description: After experiencing many things, you decide to go to Aisa Bathhouse to relax a bit...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Pals Synergy x60, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5

chapter.title: The Forest Boar and the Little Witch

dialogues.speaker: Energetic Passerby
dialogues.text: I heard there's a crazed Forest Boar wreaking havoc around the outskirts of Chinju Forest. Didn't you go for a walk there a few days ago? Did you see it?

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Passerby
dialogues.text: Uh... Nope.

dialogues.speaker: Energetic Passerby
dialogues.text: Really? Then what about that weird kid? Word is, she's been asking around that same area about some... witch.

dialogues.speaker: Energetic Passerby
dialogues.text: The rumors about that place are just bizarre... We should head over and check it out for ourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Exhausted Passerby
dialogues.text: Count me out. I just finished working overtime. All I wanna do right now is head straight home and catch up on sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Energetic Passerby
dialogues.text: Yeah, you look dead on your feet... I'd better stick with you till you get back. Don't want you passing out on the way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you hear that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, what's up with that Forest Boar?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, the part about the witch! What if it's one of the mages? C'mon, we gotta go check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to needing a break?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Meh, break shmake. Besides, Paimon doesn't believe for a second you're not curious about this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If there's a mage around here, something big must be going on! Maybe there's nothing to it, but if the rumor's true, we might be able to help out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got me there. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the place. Let's see... Any Forest Boars or mages around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, guess not... Looks like it was a false alarm! Makes sense. Paimon doesn't recall ever seeing a Forest Boar here before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And all that stuff about a "witch"? Why would they come all the way here, out into the middle of nowhere? They have way more important stuff to be doing.
That's just a stereotype.
A witch will do anything for her own amusement, even if it causes innocent people to suffer. That's why it's a Hunter's duty to—
Wait, you two... You're Alice's trusted confidants!
#The renowned duo of {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A... Hunter?
H—Hold on, let me start over.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: My name's Prune, and I'm Alice's... friend! Yeah, friend. In fact, she invited me here to take care of a... um... "witch-related incident."

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: But we lost contact due to certain... uncontrollable circumstances, so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guessing this is the weird kid who was asking around about witches?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like it.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I heard that! And don't give me that look! I'm not some weird kid wandering around for no reason!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I'm here for a... professional investigation. The point is, I know Alice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh huh. You don't sound super sure about that...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Don't believe me? Look, Alice gave me these. Witch's tools!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Surely you recognize the magical signature on them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A bell, a hammer, and... a tattered old book? Guess they could be special, but they're not exactly screaming "witch."

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Huh, that's odd. Not recognizing the first two, I can understand. But, this Spantamad textbook really means nothing to you?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}'s companion is supposed to be a well-read, high-level student at the Akademiya. According to the rumors at least...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Eighty years ago, this was the defining Spantamad text! It's a true classic.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you mean companion as in... Paimon? Man, Paimon's academic cred is off the charts!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem, which is to say... Yes, of course. That text is super, um... important and all that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Why is the bell ringing all of a sudden!?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: In theory, it detects "localized abnormal magical fluctuations".

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Unusual power surges. There must be one nearby!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hah! I just know I'm right this time. It's gotta be a witch!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so you're saying it means a witch is nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Just follow me. You'll see I'm right.

talks.objective: Follow Prune and check out the situation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nice one, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: You're just as good in battle as all the rumors say. Thanks for stepping in, and I apologize. I shouldn't have rushed in like that.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: But, I wasn't lying! Alice said that when the bell rings, a witch might appear... I just didn't realize the probability was so low.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay. We believe you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Besides, if it's one of Alice's gadgets, it must be able to do all sorts of weird things. We know all about that, don't we!

choices.text: I'm sure Alice was telling the truth...

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: ...I knew it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, hey! There's a card here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Calling all children with imaginary friends. Do you wanna accomplish something great together? If so, go off and find the Dough King."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's also a Forest Boar drawn on it... Could it be the one that's been running wild around here?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Hmph, another one of her schemes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Whaddaya mean?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: ...A plot to lure in children using the things they love the most.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: And using their own imaginary friends against them? It's despicable, reprehensible, and absolutely unforgivable!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You think it's that serious? Then, we've gotta do something!

choices.text: Let's do some digging first. Could be a misunderstanding.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There it is again! Please don't let it be more monsters...

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Considering what happened before, you're right to be cautious. I'm gonna go ahead, but I won't force you to come along.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What should we do? We can't just leave her on her own.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's follow.

choices.text: But if not, we'll make them pay!
...But probably not the whole truth.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: There's no mistake this time! This has gotta be the witch's stronghold!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Da-duh-duh-da! Gonna blow them aaaalll up!
Blow it up! Haha! Blow it up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Klee, watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess the rumor about the Forest Boar is true... But, it talks? What is it planning to blow up? Isn't this kinda concerning?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Pretty sure what Klee said is just as concerning...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh? Honorary Knight! Paimon! And Prune!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you two know each other?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep! Prune moved to Mondstadt not too long ago. She taught me this game called, "Answer or You're Toast." It's super fun!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... what?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: But hey! I told you not to tell anyone about that!

choices.text: What did Klee do to you?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: It's not like that! It's just a game where you answer questions, and in return, you get to eat toasted snacks!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that sounds right up Paimon's alley...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: You should come next time, Paimon! The more people we have, the bigger we can make the fire, and the more fun it'll be!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Ahem! Never mind that for now! What are you doing here, Klee? This animal didn't hurt you, did he?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: No, no! He wouldn't hurt me. We were just playing. This is Popcorn, my new friend.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... He looks exactly like the drawing on this card!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, yeah. That's the request for help that the Dough King drew! But don't worry, the Hexenzirkel's on the case!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: The Hexenzirkel!? Do you know where the witches are, Klee? C'mon, you can tell me.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah, they're inside this secret base. I'll go get them! Back in a flash!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Hah, I was right! I knew they had to be close this time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, why do you look like you're gearing up to fight a monster?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Trust me, these witches are—

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ta-da!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The Little Hexenzirkel, reporting for duty!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: We just talked it over, and Yaoyao said we should put the "little" in front because we all still have growing to do.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: (The Little Hexenzirkel!? What in the world is that? She never mentioned it before...)

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ahem, I'm little witch Klee. Oh, and the Little Hexenzirkel was my idea.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: #Hehe, it's always a good day when I get to see you two again, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, right! Klee mentioned she was bringing a new friend to the base. Guess we should introduce ourselves then.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I'm little witch Yaoyao from Liyue. I just joined the Little Hexenzirkel, and I'm looking forward to learning a lot!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Oh, uh... Hi.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Your turn, Qiqi. Nice and slow, just like we practiced, okay? Still remember what you wrote down?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Mhm. I am little witch Qiqi. That's all.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon... are in my heart. I can remember them without writing things down.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: New friend is... a new face. I will... try to remember.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: *yawn*... Ah... My turn? Hello, you two. Oh, and our new friend here. I'm little witch Sayu.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Um... Hello frie— Or, uh, witches. You can call me Prune.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A Little Hexenzirkel! That's so cute!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure looks like the real deal! You even have introduction magic, just like Alice and Nicole!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hehe, Mom's a super impressive witch. Guess I just take after her!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Prune! So, when you said there were witches around here, you were talking about Klee and the others?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Y—Yes, of course. A little witch is still a witch, after all.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: (Was this Alice's idea? Does this organization take orders from the main Hexenzirkel...?)

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: ...Prune is the best! She's my friend. Oh, and Mom said she's her friend too!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: What!? Your mom said we were... friends?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's with the surprise? Didn't she just tell us herself she was Alice's friend...?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So, Paimon, Prune... Wanna join the Little Hexenzirkel?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Do it, do it! You can come into our secret hideout, and we can all share snacks and toys!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Plus, you get to share Mom's cool introduction magic too! She said I can use it on all the little witches!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: I'll pass. I stopped playing pretend a long time ago.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Unlimited snacks are one thing, but self-introduction magic too? That's so cool!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds like Paimon's in!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, no... Paimon's not ready! Alice also loves putting people through trials, remember? What if Klee inherited that trait too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't swear allegiance now. She'll look like such a joke if she doesn't pass the test...

choices.text: Don't worry. You have me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: U—Um, so fellow little witches... Does Paimon need to pass some sort of trial to join the little Hexenzirkel?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Nope, all it takes is an invitation from Klee. That's how we joined.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's a lot simpler than Paimon thought!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: That's to be expected. A child's world is simple. Adults are the ones who make things complicated.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So Paimon's a little witch now? Oooh, what's her introduction magic gonna be...?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mom says the content of the introduction is super important, 'cause it's kinda like a first impression. So the person who knows the little witch best should decide.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Just picture it in your head, then hold my hand, and the magic will transfer!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let me decide then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, yeah! You definitely know Paimon best!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, in your eyes, what kind of a little witch would Paimon be...

choices.text: A true force to be reckoned with...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Okay, Paimon. Hold out your hand.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Done! Alright little witch Paimon, go ahead and introduce yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's it? Okay, here goes nothing. Ahem...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hello everyone! Little witch Paimon reporting for duty!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Congratulations. Uh, but, um... Shouldn't we get down to business? Something doesn't seem right with this boar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you said the Little Hexenzirkel is working on a quest, right, Klee? Now that Paimon's a member, she should get all caught up, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what's the situation?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: The whole Popcorn thing is super complicated... It's gonna take ages to explain. Can we at least find somewhere to sit down first? Standing is so tiring...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oooh! Let's have a tea party, then! Tea parties are perfect for long conversations.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Great idea. I'll be in charge of snacks and drinks!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Oh! I'll get the chairs.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And I'll get some toys for us to play with.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Um...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: You can come with me, Qiqi. Help me pick out some good snacks.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: You're more than welcome to explore our secret base in the meantime, Honorary Knight and Prune!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Alright... Guess I can do some reading while I wait.

choices.text: Cute and adorable beyond compare...
We'll make a little witch out of you yet!
What did you do to Klee?

talks.objective: Wait for the little witches' tea party to start

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: If you're looking for something to pass the time, you two should try out this mechanism.

choices.text: Sure, let's do it!
I think I'll look around a bit more first.

talks.objective: Join the little witches' tea party

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sayuuu! You're sleeping again? Are you really that tired?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Yeah... I moved those chairs, and I had to give Gena all those directions... It was hard work, so I rewarded myself with a nap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Jina"? Ohhh, like short for Mujina? Cute!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I knew it! I knew people were gonna think that. No, it's a name! A regular name! It's not short for anything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay. Not short for anything. Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, Gena's my imaginary friend by the way. She's invisible to people most of the time, so I never introduced you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon never really thought about it before, but... of course you all have imaginary friends! That's what kids do, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Shh! Don't call me a "kid," or you're gonna jinx my chances of getting taller! Soon, I'm gonna be a full-fledged ninja who can hold her own. I just know it.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: But before then, I guess it doesn't hurt to tackle things with a friend...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Besides, even if Gena helps me, it's not like most people would see. So, it would still look like I could hold my own.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know "holding your own" and "being alone" are two different things, right?

choices.text: Haha, guess it's open to interpretation.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? Great! I have this ninjutsu device here that you can use to train with her!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I've been so busy with the other little witches, training has kind of taken a backseat...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you're not telling us this so you can slack off while we do it for you, right?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: What? Um, no! It's not like that!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: This device is for escape training. Sensei left it for me, but as you know, I'm already really good at running away.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I don't need help with my own training assignments. I finished those ages ago.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: It's Gena... She's even lazier than me. If we're gonna make a break for it together, she has to be able to keep up. So she needs to finish her training.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: That's what I'm hoping to get some, um... help with.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... How is asking us to "help" not slacking off?

choices.text: I'm curious to see what Gena looks like.

talks.objective: Join the little witches' tea party

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ta-da! Welcome to the little witch's tea party!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Want something to drink, Prune? Too far to reach? Here, Paimon'll help.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Ahem, thanks. I'll have a hot tea then. No sugar.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, we actually don't have tea here. It's too bitter. None of us like it.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I don't like hot things. Dango Milk is cold, like coconut milk. I like it.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Well, if there's no other option, then... I suppose I'll have Dango Milk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kinda seems like you were eyeing that from the beginning...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Ahem, let's just get on with the meeting!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: You were going to tell us what the deal is with this Forest Boar...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Right! Popcorn is an imaginary friend!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: No, that can't be right. We shouldn't be able to see other people's imaginary friends in the real world.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we were only able to meet your imaginary friends thanks to magic, adeptal arts, and ninjutsu.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And before, we used Lisa's monocle detector thing...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: What sort of evidence do you have that Popcorn is an imaginary friend?

dialogues.speaker: Popcorn
dialogues.text: Imaginary friend! Real friend!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Um... I don't know. But, I believe him!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Let's try a different question, then... How did you find him?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh, we were playing outside, and we found the Dough King's request for help! So, we followed the trail and found the Dough King and Popcorn.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: The Dough King's super nice! Popcorn was just wandering around. It was the Dough King who found him first!

dialogues.speaker: Popcorn
dialogues.text: Nice, haha. Nice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Is Popcorn always like this? Doesn't really seem like he can hold a conversation...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Popcorn was in bad shape, wandering alone. Angry, running super fast... The Dough King looked worried.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: He's much better with us. Even talks and smiles sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Well, most imaginary friends are dreamed up by kids, so it makes sense that he'd feel more comfortable around them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. So, to get this straight... The Dough King found Popcorn wandering around, lost...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then teamed up with the Little Hexenzirkel to get to the bottom of it?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep! We're in charge of looking after Popcorn while the Dough King does some investigating. We're gonna meet up tomorrow.

choices.text: Guess we were wrong then.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Well... I didn't say it one-hundred percent was. I was just hypothesizing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what's the Little Hexenzirkel planning to do next?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: We're gonna do what little witches do best, and help him out!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: How? By using the same kind of magic the big witches use?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I don't know. I've never been a witch before... What do you think we should do, Prune?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: You're the witches, not me. How am I supposed to...

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: (Wait, this could be a chance to get some insider intel...)

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Ahem, obviously, the best place to start is with... imitation! We need to learn from the big Hexenzirkel. So, it couldn't hurt to... go through the members and list their strengths.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, um... Well first, there's Mom. She's just like me and loves going on big adventures with her friends!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Then, there's my auntie who tells prophecies.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: If you ask me, Popcorn turned out this way because he didn't get enough sleep. Sleeping solves everything. In fact, I think the best idea is for all of us to just take a nap right now.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: ...Oh, and another auntie who talks a lot.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: We shouldn't just jump to conclusions. We need to do our due vigilance... Or, uh, diligence? Point is, this is an important task.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I'm not sure we can get to the bottom of it right now. But while we wait for news from the Dough King, we can at least play with Popcorn and keep him occupied. Y'know, so he doesn't go around scaring people.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And another who loved writing stories.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Crossing out "sleep," but keeping "adventures" and "playtime"... Got it.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Then, there's a super smart one, and... I forgot the rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Come on, brain! Work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, here's an idea! Imaginary friends don't exist without a kid thinking them up, right? So, why don't we try to ask about the kid he belongs to?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Good thinking, Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Popcorn? Where's your human? How did you guys get split up?

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Oh! Ha! Smash smash smash! Homura is hurting. Gotta help her! You gotta help her!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Homura must be his human, then... What happened to her? How can we help?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: The Dough King said Popcorn probably has amnesia and can't remember much.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Hm, like Qiqi. But Qiqi and Popcorn are also different, because Popcorn can't write.

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Homura can write!

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Bring on the tear-bugs. Bring on the booger-beasts. Mean, or nasty, or in your face, one punch sends them to outer space!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Yeah... Popcorn's been repeating that a lot.

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Give them one great monstrous whack, then stuff 'em in a big ol' sack!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did Homura write that? Huh. It's definitely got personality!

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Blown away! Woo hoo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... maybe she's destined to be some kind of... new-age poet when she gets older?

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Famous painter! Famous chef! World-famous filmmaker!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Hey, high expectations put a lot of pressure on a kid, you know. What if she doesn't live up to them?

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Homura is the best! No matter what!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Can you tell us what she looks like? We'll help you find her.

response.speaker: Popcorn
response.text: Loves pigtails, floral dresses, smiling. And also... *boar noise*!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Yeah, this is getting us nowhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess that's all we can get for now. What's our next move?

choices.text: You said the Dough King was also investigating...

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Yeah, guess that's all we can do. Meeting adjourned, then?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! Let's go play!

choices.text: Let's wait until tomorrow and we can combine our intel.
That card we found wasn't a trap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Find any good toys to bring, Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah! Mom made me this magic toy so that Dodoco and me can play with bombs together. I'm gonna bring it to the tea party so all the little witches can join in too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You want everyone to... play with bombs together!? That's way too dangerous for a tea party!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's not dangerous! The toy makes it so that Jumpy Dumpty doesn't explode, so I can use it all I want without getting sent to confinement. That's what Mom said!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: You guys should come play too! Dodoco came to Inazuma with me and really wants to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... But, you usually carry Dodoco with you, don't you? We met ages ago, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: No, not that Dodoco! The Dodo Clan has lots of Dodocos. Some are like me, and like going on exciting adventures in new places.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But a lot of Dodocos live in a different place most of the time, so you haven't met them yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A different place?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah! Back in Mondstadt, Prune showed me a picture book about it. She said that place is a... made-up world for kids, and Dodoco is my imaginary friend.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But no matter where Dodocos come from, Mom always finds a way to bring them here to play. Like this time, she put Dodoco in a magic toy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we've seen all kinds of Dodocos at this point, but it still feels amazing every time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing like a bit of magic, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: So, you gonna play bombs with us? Please, please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's do it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm gonna explore a little longer. Let's play later.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ready to play bombs with Dodoco?

choices.text: Sure, let's go!
I'm gonna explore a little longer. Let's play later.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Qiqi, you can't just drink sugary stuff. I told you how many glasses of water to have a day. Still remember?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: One two three four. Two two three four... Um, no...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It's okay! That's what I'm for. Your personal... hydration assistant, hehe! No better time than the present. Here, have some now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww... You really look out for Qiqi, huh, Yaoyao.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Perfect timing! What kind of snacks do you like? Salty? Sweet? Let's see what we have...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's bag is full of snacks too. Pick out whatever you like!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Snacks and toys are meant for sharing. Here.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh! This is the toy Auntie Cloud Retainer made for us. She built a lot of fun adeptal arts into it.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: After she heard from Master that we were coming to Inazuma, she lectured us all about being safe on our own.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: But, she didn't think telling us would be enough, so she made us this mechanism to play with. She said the most effective lessons are the ones combined with fun!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Be home before dark. Tuantuan and Yuegui go together. Qiqi and Yaoyao have to hold hands.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Yep, that's what she said, huh! Nice remembering, Qiqi!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Auntie Cloud Retainer's adeptal arts are amazing! She made a whole domain where our imaginary friends can play. I even got to meet Qiqi's imaginary friend for the first time, too!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: She's a cute little finch, just as adorable as Qiqi herself! Her name is Tuantuan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qiqi's obsession with finches is suddenly starting to make a lot more sense...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Yuegui... is like the mechanical Yuegui, but different...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Just in case you're confused, Yuegui is also my imaginary friend. It all started after Auntie Cloud Retainer gave me the mechanical Yuegui. We've grown up a lot together since then.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Tuantuan's grown too. She got chubbier, but she can also fly higher.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, that's awesome! Real or imaginary, it's nice to grow up with friends by your side.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh, shoot! I almost forgot I'm supposed to be in charge of drinks! I'll be done soon! You guys should try out this mechanism in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, let's do it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I'll look around a bit more first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, we'll do it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Think I'll... slack off for once too. I'll help out later.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Please take over Gena's escape training. Help me slack off, just this once...?

choices.text: Alright, we'll do it.
Think I'll... slack off for once too. I'll help out later.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Leveraging Elemental combinations to boost damage output... Hm, it's clear that with the right strategy, no opponent is invincible — even a witch.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: The Cryo Whopperflower just now was nothing more than a plant mimic. It didn't seem like the kind of monster a witch would summon.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: #Faced with its burrowing and Cryo spike attacks, evasive maneuvers are of particular importance. {NICKNAME}'s footwork alone is a revelation that deserves to be studied, not to mention {M#his}{F#her} combat moves... I'd better make some notes...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: "Hunting Training (Revised): Draft 16"... Done!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Watcha writin' there, Prune?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Whoa, you scared me! You have to at least make a sound if you're gonna walk over here like that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, Paimon doesn't walk. She flies.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. Did you, um... hear all that just now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, something about hunting training?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: In that case, I need to tell you something. I know it's going to sound unbelievable, but just hear me out.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: See this book here? Alice gave it to me, but there were a few loose pages tucked inside... magical pages that transform whatever's written on them into a real place.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I know it's hard to imagine, but think of it like... being able to go inside a fairytale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so like Simulanka? We went there ages ago.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: (Simu... what now? I've never heard of that place! Wait, does that mean there's actually a fairytale book that people can go inside...?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what kind of fairytale did you write, Prune? Can we go inside and take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Pfft, I'd never waste them on something so childish and unrealistic. There are only a few sheets of this paper. The obvious choice is to use them for my own benefit.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: So, after teaching myself all the material in this textbook, I wrote up a full combat training plan. With a little time, I'll be able to take down Alice with my own two hands!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Didn't you say you were friends? What's this about "taking her down"?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: (Shoot! I got too excited and let it slip...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, wait a second...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: (Oh no... Is the cat out of the bag?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That just means you're super good friends, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #We have a friend like that, too! Always challenging {NICKNAME} to a sparring match whenever there's a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}'s got a pretty impressive reputation, after all! Y'know, Prune, if you're looking to improve your combat skills, you could always just ask {M#him}{F#her}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Volunteering me for things again, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Of course! What am I doing copying down techniques in secret, when I could go straight to the source!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: #Would you join my practice session, {NICKNAME}? Seeing you in action would be an invaluable resource!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll show you what I've got!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not a problem. Let me just take care of something first.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: #Would you join my practice session, {NICKNAME}? Seeing you in action would be an invaluable resource!

choices.text: Alright, I'll show you what I've got!
Not a problem. Let me just take care of something first.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Everyone, it's the Little Hexenzirkel's three-day anniversary! How many days 'till we reach 100... Um, not sure I can count that high...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But, but! I know there's 7 more days until day 10! Ten is such a big number, huh! You need all your fingers to count that much!

choices.text: This has been fun.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Well, after Sayu, Klee, and I met on Dragonspine that one time, we promised to play together.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: So, when I got Sayu's invitation, I asked Master and Dr. Baizhu if I could bring Qiqi along. They thought it was a great chance for Qiqi to meet some new friends, so here we are.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: This is Qiqi's first time here. The sakura are pretty. The red girl smiles a lot. The sleepy girl, um... sleeps a lot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about you, Klee? Did you come by yourself?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep! I've been to Inazuma before, so I knew the way! Mom said it's good to, um... broaden my horizons as I get older, so she was all for it!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Besides, Mr. Albedo and Durin were with me until I got on the boat. Then, there were a bunch of nice adventurers to keep me company! And as soon as I got off, Sayu was right there on the dock waiting for me!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Yep. This is my reward for completing a really tough mission for the Shuumatsuban. The boss gave me the time off and funds to invite some friends here, and the shrine maidens agreed to help host them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Awww. It's so nice seeing you guys having so much fun together...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah, it's like... being surrounded by Dodocos! I'm having a blast!

choices.text: What brings the little witches to Inazuma, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: So, Popcorn's the name, huh... Think hard, Popcorn. Were you captured by a woman? She would've been pretty. Almost too pretty...

dialogues.speaker: Popcorn
dialogues.text: No more tear-bugs! Blast 'em! Blast 'em all away!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hah, I knew it! You're out for revenge too, huh. I wouldn't be surprised if she ends up being the Dough King.

dialogues.speaker: Popcorn
dialogues.text: No more booger-beasts! Blast 'em! Blast 'em all away!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hmm... How about this — have you seen a puppy around? Cute and small? He's an imaginary friend too!

dialogues.speaker: Popcorn
dialogues.text: Blast 'em! Blast 'em all away! Stuff 'em in a big ol' sack!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: You... have no idea what I'm saying, do you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, it's just been one thing after another lately... Paimon could sure use a break.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we go to Aisa Bathhouse for a bit? Always nice to rest up before we set off again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Monster!? You said it was gonna be a witch!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Shoot, I forgot my hammer back there! Sorry, but could you take care of this while I go get it? Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the little witch's tea party is ready!
